title: PLA Activity Moderates: 2 Sorties, 5 PLAN Vessels, 3 Official Ships
detail: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense detected 2 PLA aircraft sorties, 5 PLAN vessels, and 3 official ships operating around Taiwan in the 24-hour window ending 06:00 (UTC+8) on July 10, 2026 — continuing the relatively moderate activity level following the July 6 SLBM test and July 7 ADIZ incursion. ROC Armed Forces monitored the situation with standard CAP, naval, and coastal missile deployments.
